name: Red Mountain
source: RED Mountain, a small graphic adventure made in Renpy, a short but intense experience, in this crimson red forest, we will meet two VERY close brothers, Killita and Artema, two very experienced hunters from the Crimson Forest region, brothers who... believe me, you don't want to meet in person.
